premium_discount.growth_outlook: Management guides to low-to-mid single digit net sales growth in fiscal 2025, with Services growing in the low double digits and an AI-feature-driven Orchard Phone upgrade cycle, after 2% growth ($391.0 billion) in fiscal 2024.
premium_discount.margin_trajectory: Gross margin expanded 210 basis points to 46.2% on the Services mix shift (Services now 25% of sales at a 73.9% gross margin); guidance of 46% to 47% and modest operating margin expansion implies further, slower, improvement as component costs rise.
key_risks: Greater China net sales fell 8% amid renminbi weakness and share loss
Regulatory or judicial changes to the default search licensing arrangement could cut Services revenue and margin
Antitrust investigations and litigation over the app distribution platform
Concentrated outsourced manufacturing in Asia exposed to tariffs and trade disputes
premium_discount.rationale: FIXA trades at 24.5x EV/EBITDA and 30.0x P/E versus peer medians of 18.0x and 24.0x. The premium is justified by a 46.2% gross margin that is still expanding, a Services annuity that now represents a quarter of revenue at a 74% gross margin, and $118.3 billion of operating cash flow funding $110.2 billion of capital returns; the modest top-line growth guide and China exposure argue against a wider gap.
